purpose: Ten minimalist redesign concepts grounded in the actual CRM screenshots

concepts.name: Чистый монохром
concepts.ux: Белый интерфейс, тонкие разделители, компактный Sidebar и чёрная основная кнопка.
concepts.direction: Pure monochrome utility minimalism. White header, white 200px sidebar and white working canvas. Charcoal text, cool-gray secondary text, single black primary create button. Separate sidebar from content with just one fine gray vertical rule. 28px regular clean grotesk page title, compact 14px lane labels with small tabular counts. Precise 1px hairline card outlines, 6px radii, no shadows. Neutral low-contrast source/course tags, outlined quick actions, slim dividers between name/contact and footer. Very restrained typographic hierarchy and a consistent compact 8px spacing grid. No colored lane backgrounds, no decorative filled panels.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one polished MINIMALIST redesign of the user's real 01 Academy CRM, grounded in the five actual screenshots attached.
Input roles: Image 1 is the actual sales pipeline and the output's main functional foundation. Image 2 is the actual academy overview, Image 3 the actual calendar, Image 4 the actual clients table, Image 5 the actual MODAL lead Sheet; images 2–5 provide product context. Re-design this real product, preserving its actual functions and fields. The user now wants minimalist styles.
Output ONE full-width straight-on desktop CRM screenshot, landscape 16:9, no browser chrome, collage, device, perspective, captions outside the UI or watermark.
Show the actual sales Kanban, not a generic analytics dashboard. Title "Воронка продаж", funnel "Основная воронка", create "Новая заявка", filters "Фильтры лидов". Four existing stage labels in order: "Новый лид", "Ответственный назначен", "Недозвон", "Перезвонить позже"; first three stage counts 113, 11, 104. Show at least four lanes and three complete lead cards per lane. Preserve name, masked phone, source, course, manager, multiselect checkbox, overflow menu, unread marker, and quick actions "Записать на демо" and "Оплата". Do not delete functionality to achieve a minimalist look. Card details continue opening in a MODAL Dialog/Sheet; don't render an open modal or an inline details panel. Destructive operations retain confirmation.
Navigation retains all seven actual Sales destinations: "Обзор продаж", "Воронка продаж", "Архив лидов", "Расписание занятий", "Все клиенты", "Входящие", "Журнал звонков". Retain the five modules "Продажи", "Преподаватель", "Маркетинг", "Финансы", "Администрирование", plus "Задачи". Navigation may be a compact Sidebar or top Tabs/module rail as specified by this direction. Retain search, theme switch, notifications, messages, language and account controls. Preserve the actual logo silhouette and 01 Academy wordmark, in compatible colors.
Privacy: use only fictional contacts "Алексей К.", "Мария С.", "Даниил П.", "Елена В.", manager "Менеджер А." or "Менеджер Б.", masked phone "+998 •• ••• •• ••". Current account label "Мой аккаунт" and initials "АК". Never copy actual personal names or phone digits from the references. Sources ONLY "Instagram", "Meta Lead Ads", "Telegram", "01academy.uz". Courses ONLY "AI Kids", "Vibe Coding", "AI Creator". No invented English courses, "Chat AI" or other source names. Russian functional UI except existing brand/course names.
Minimalism means restrained typography, consistent spacing, fewer visual containers, quiet metadata, clear hierarchy, little or no shadow, and one restrained accent. Use normal-size titles and small stage counts, practical desktop information density and readable high-contrast text. Keep controls discoverable with adequate click areas. No huge typographic experiments, decorative imagery, color-blocked stages, neon, glass, heavy shadows or ornamental UI. Do not introduce charts, KPI cards, AI assistants, new workflows, features, technical explanations or service text.

Precise 1px hairline card outlines, 6px radii, no shadows. Neutral low-contrast source/course tags, outlined quick actions, slim dividers between name/contact and footer. concepts.name: Спокойный графит
concepts.ux: Тёмная рабочая область, спокойный контраст, один сдержанный акцент.
concepts.direction: Quiet professional dark minimalism. Matte graphite #202226 canvas, very slightly darker compact sidebar and header, restrained #292C31 cards with almost imperceptible borders. Warm offwhite primary text, sufficiently legible gray secondary text. One muted pale cyan accent used only for create button and active sidebar indicator; stage headers and badges remain neutral. 26px medium grotesk page title, compact counts, no giant figures. Crisp thin line icons, narrow header, 6px card corners. Calm legible business workspace, no glows, gradients, colored lane headers, glossy materials or decorative shapes.

concepts.name: Тёплая бумага
concepts.ux: Молочные поверхности, мягкая типографика, нейтральные метки и минимум рамок.
concepts.direction: Warm paper minimalism, calm editorial taste adapted for real operations. Offwhite #F7F5EF canvas and side navigation, near-white cards. Ink #33312D text, warm taupe supporting labels. Modest 29px refined serif page heading paired with clear humanist sans for all functional UI. Single muted olive primary action; active sidebar item indicated by a short fine ink rule without a large pill. Card separation mainly through careful white space and a fine bottom divider, quiet 4px corner outlines only where needed. Source and course labels are small neutral typographic chips. No paper texture, illustrations, orange highlights or giant typography.
